name: Spine Rotation
definition: A seated fixed-path trunk isolation performed one rotation direction at a time while the pelvis and lower body remain position-held. The one active record prescribes equal work in both mirrored directions so direction-aggregated oblique volume is not credited from only one rotation direction. Vinstrup directly reviewed the left-to-right direction in a horizontal seated machine: feet behind ankle rollers, hands on handles at shoulder height, a photographed shoulder-pad lever supplying the load interface, controlled left-to-right rotation, and a controlled return. The right-to-left prescription is an explicit mirrored mechanics-and-training adaptation, not a claim that Vinstrup measured that direction. The paper calls the task torso rotation but did not measure pelvis kinematics; holding the pelvis against the seat is likewise an explicit catalog coaching adaptation, not a measured zero-motion result. Obliques are the sole primary. Vinstrup directly measured external oblique, while Stevens measured both internal and external obliques during dynamic resisted seated axial rotation; Vivobody's one bilateral obliques region cannot encode their side-specific, internal-versus-external recruitment strategy. Rectus-abdominis and erector-spinae activity observed by Vinstrup is not converted into abs or lumbarExtensors stabilizer credit because those signals do not establish categorical workout-volume roles. Standing band twists, cable rotations, wood chops, Russian twists, landmine rotations, medicine-ball throws, diagonal flexion-rotation, anti-rotation holds, alternating-direction repetitions, and any repetition driven by the hips or legs remain outside this contract.

execution.startingPosition: Sit in a horizontal torso-twist machine with the feet behind the ankle rollers, the shoulder pads in contact, and both hands holding the separate handles at shoulder height.
execution.movement: For one logged direction, begin rotated left and drive the shoulder pads from left to right in a controlled motion.
execution.endpoint: Turn as far as feels comfortable.
execution.returnPhase: Return to the left-facing start under control.
execution.controlledJoints: Hold the pelvis against the seat and keep the hips and legs still.
execution.supportAndPosture: Stay seated with the shoulder pads in contact and both hands holding the handles.
disqualifyingCompensations: Letting the pelvis rotate with the pads turns the torso twist into a whole-body spin.
Pushing with the legs or hips turns the torso twist into a lower-body heave.
execution.sideOrDirection: Reset the machine, repeat the same movement from right to left, and log that direction separately. Treat the right-to-left direction as a mirrored training adaptation and do not alternate directions within a repetition.
